Riley: Weekend poll Two low-effort options: group bike ride along the pier on Saturday morning or a boardgame & ramen night at my place Saturday evening. Vote with 'bike' or 'games' :bicyclist: :game_die:
Sam: bike 10am meet by the ferry?
Nadia: games 60a ramen sounds amazing. I can bring dumplings.
Diego: bike for me too. Might be slow pace 643
Riley: quick reminder: free rack parking near the ferry lot, bring lights if you have them. Link to meetup spot: https://maps.app/ferry-rack
Sam: also, tea-bot says we still have ginger tea in the pantry if anyone wants after-ride warming :tea:
tea-bot: Pantry update: ginger tea (7 bags), matcha (2 tins). Please replenish if used.
Nadia: tally: bike Sam, Diego (2). games Nadia (1). Riley?
Riley: I can do either but I saw more bike interest. I'll lock in bike + casual coffee at 10am; games & ramen becomes a fallback if anyone drops. DM me if you need the exact spot. :thumbsup:
